name: MYAIO – Your AI-Powered Co-Founder
author: gabrielwillkinson1

sections.description:
MYAIO – Your AI-Powered Co-Founder connects your WordPress site to the MYAIO platform (https://app.myaio.com/) using an API key.

After activation, the plugin exposes secure REST API endpoints that allow the MYAIO platform to:

  • Retrieve SEO-related site data for audits (titles, meta descriptions, headings, indexability signals, and selected on-page details), and
  • If you enable deployment features, apply supported SEO updates such as Open Graph tags, Twitter cards, schema markup, canonical links, robots meta directives, and related settings.

The plugin does not automatically change your site. All deployment actions are initiated from the MYAIO platform after you connect your site and explicitly use those features.

MYAIO – Your AI-Powered Co-Founder does not promise rankings or traffic. SEO results depend on many external factors beyond the plugin’s control.

Key Features

  • Secure API-key based connection to the MYAIO platform
  • Read-only SEO audit data endpoints
  • Optional deployment endpoints for supported SEO tags
  • Admin-controlled activation and configuration
  • No front-end output or visitor tracking by default
  • Compatible with existing SEO plugins

Getting Started

  1. Create an account at https://app.myaio.com/
  2. Generate an API key from your MYAIO dashboard.
  3. Enter the API key in the plugin settings.
  4. Run audits and manage recommendations from the MYAIO platform.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to provide its audit, reporting, and deployment functionality. All external communication occurs only as a result of explicit administrator actions or when a related feature is actively used.

MYAIO Platform

The plugin communicates with the MYAIO platform at https://app.myaio.com/ for API key verification, connection management, SEO audits, and optional deployment actions. When verifying the API key, the plugin sends the site URL, an API key identifier, and connection status information. SEO-related site data (such as page URLs, titles, meta descriptions, headings, schema, and indexability signals) is accessed via the plugin’s REST API endpoints only when the administrator explicitly initiates audits or deployment actions.

Terms of Service: https://app.myaio.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://app.myaio.com/privacy

Third-Party SEO & Analytics Services

Certain audit and reporting features within the MYAIO platform rely on third-party services for domain authority metrics, page performance analysis, search analytics, and keyword insights. When these features are used, relevant data such as site URLs, property identifiers, or query parameters may be sent to the respective service providers.

These requests are made only when the site administrator enables and uses the specific feature that requires the service. No data is sent to third-party services passively or without administrator action.

All third-party services are subject to their own terms of service and privacy policies. For details, refer to the MYAIO platform documentation.

Privacy

This plugin does not add front-end scripts or track site visitors by default.

External requests are performed only when initiated by the site administrator or when using a feature that requires an external service. API keys are stored in WordPress options and are not exposed publicly.

Uninstall

When the plugin is deleted, it removes its stored options and temporary data. It does not modify WordPress core files, themes, or unrelated content.

Website

https://app.myaio.com
sections.installation:
1. Search MYAIO Your AI-Powered Co-Founder and install the plugin and activate it.
  2. Open the plugin settings page in WordPress admin.
  3. Enter your MYAIO API key and save to verify the connection.
